long_biography.plain_text:
Valentino Rossi won world titles across the 125cc, 250cc, 500cc and MotoGP classes. His move from Honda to Yamaha became a defining competitive decision: he won again with a different manufacturer and remained a leading figure in the championship for many more seasons.

After leaving full-time motorcycle racing, Rossi moved into endurance car competition. In Tavullia, he established a training academy where young Italian riders could develop alongside experienced racers. His MotoGP team grew from a junior-class project into a premier-class operation, giving him a continuing role in the sport as a team owner.
long_biography.html:
Valentino Rossi won world titles across the 125cc, 250cc, 500cc and MotoGP classes. His move from Honda to Yamaha became a defining competitive decision: he won again with a different manufacturer and remained a leading figure in the championship for many more seasons.

After leaving full-time motorcycle racing, Rossi moved into endurance car competition. In Tavullia, he established a training academy where young Italian riders could develop alongside experienced racers. His MotoGP team grew from a junior-class project into a premier-class operation, giving him a continuing role in the sport as a team owner.
